items.title: Awesome Neuroscience
items.content_text:
### Programming / Python

*   [DeepLabCut (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut) - Markerless pose estimation toolkit for animal behavior analysis using transfer learning with deep neural networks.
*   [CaImAn (⭐722)](https://github.com/flatironinstitute/CaImAn) - Computational toolbox for large-scale calcium imaging data analysis, including motion correction, source extraction, and deconvolution.
*   [Elephant (⭐239)](https://github.com/NeuralEnsemble/elephant) - Library for the analysis of electrophysiology data, providing tools for spike train statistics, signal processing, and connectivity analysis.
items.content_html:
Programming / Python

  • DeepLabCut (⭐5.6k) - Markerless pose estimation toolkit for animal behavior analysis using transfer learning with deep neural networks.

  • Elephant (⭐239) - Library for the analysis of electrophysiology data, providing tools for spike train statistics, signal processing, and connectivity analysis.
